sections.title: Number Theory and Computation
sections.scope: Number sets (natural, whole, integers, rational, irrational), factors and multiples, HCF and LCM, operations with fractions, decimals and percentages, standard form, ratio, proportion and sequences.

sections.title: Consumer Arithmetic
sections.scope: Personal budgeting, business transactions, and savings and investment.

sections.title: Sets

sections.scope: SI units, perimeter, area and volume.
